title: Best Photos From 2026 CMA Awards Red Carpet: Taylor Swift, Lainey Wilson, Megan Moroney & More
summary: Swift returns to the show (and the red carpet) for her first CMA performance in 13 years.
contentText:
The 2026 CMA Awards have arrived at Nashville’s Bridgestone Arena — but before any prizes are handed out on Wednesday night (Nov. 18), country music’s biggest stars made a splashy entrance on the red carpet.

Country-turned-pop superstar Taylor Swift made her grand return to the CMA Awards, performing at the show for the first time in 13 years thanks to her nomination for “I Knew It, I Knew You,” from Toy Story 5 . She wore a bright-yellow strapless dress on the red carpet and posed for photos with returning host Lainey Wilson, who also opted for a yellow dress, though hers was a more pastel shade.

Other stars who hit the red carpet: Megan Moroney, Lee Ann Womack, Darius Rucker, Bailey Zimmerman and Randy Travis, who shared a sweet kiss with wife Mary Davis on the carpet.

At Wednesday’s show, “Choosin’ Texas” hitmaker Ella Langley leads all artists with nine nominations and ties the record for the most nods in one year by a female artist (matching her “Texas” co-writer Miranda Lambert’s 2010 and 2014 hauls and Lainey Wilson’s 2023 tally). This year, Lambert follows Langley with seven nominations; Kacey Musgraves and producer Ben West have five; while Cody Johnson, Chris Stapleton and Stephen Wilson Jr. have four each. Lainey Wilson, who will return as host for the third time (and the second as a solo host), earned three nods.

The show will air on ABC and stream live on Disney + for the first time and will include performances from Lambert, Langley, Tim McGraw and many more, in addition to Swift.
